I read the Notion OpenAPI specs (`openapi.json` and `openapi-adminApi.json`), the "Changes by version" page and the page-markdown and append-children reference pages. Method and path come from the specs. Standard endpoints are served at `https://api.notion.com/v1/...`. Admin endpoints are at `https://api.notion.com/admin/v1/...`, which I took from the Admin versioning page's curl example. The specs list only `/v1/...`.

## 1. Cursor pagination

Standard API:

| Endpoint | Method | Path | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| List all users | GET | `/v1/users` | |
| Retrieve a page property item | GET | `/v1/pages/{page_id}/properties/{property_id}` | Paginated for list-type properties |
| Retrieve block children | GET | `/v1/blocks/{block_id}/children` | |
| Query a data source | POST | `/v1/data_sources/{data_source_id}/query` | |
| List data source templates | GET | `/v1/data_sources/{data_source_id}/templates` | |
| Search by title | POST | `/v1/search` | |
| List comments | GET | `/v1/comments` | |
| List file uploads | GET | `/v1/file_uploads` | |
| List custom emojis | GET | `/v1/custom_emojis` | |
| List views | GET | `/v1/views` | |
| Get view query results | GET | `/v1/views/{view_id}/queries/{query_id}` | |
| Query meeting notes | POST | `/v1/blocks/meeting_notes/query` | The response is paginated, but the spec shows no `start_cursor` input |
| Query agents | POST | `/v1/agents/query` | |
| Query sessions | POST | `/v1/sessions/query` | |
| Query session events | POST | `/v1/sessions/{session_id}/events/query` | |
| List skills plugins | GET | `/v1/ai/plugins` | |

Append block children (PATCH `/v1/blocks/{block_id}/children`) returns a list-shaped response, but it takes no cursor input, so I left it out.

Admin API: every list endpoint below also paginates.

| Endpoint | Method | Path |
|---|---|---|
| List analytics reports | GET | `/v1/analytics/reports` |
| List legal holds | GET | `/v1/legal_holds` |
| List users on a legal hold | GET | `/v1/legal_holds/{legal_hold_id}/users` |
| List workspaces on a legal hold | GET | `/v1/legal_holds/{legal_hold_id}/workspaces` |
| List pages on a legal hold | GET | `/v1/legal_holds/{legal_hold_id}/spaces/{space_id}/pages` |
| List MCP client connections | GET | `/v1/mcp_client_connections` |
| List groups | GET | `/v1/spaces/{space_id}/groups` |
| List group members | GET | `/v1/spaces/{space_id}/groups/{group_id}/members` |
| List users | GET | `/v1/spaces/{space_id}/users` |
| List personal access tokens | GET | `/v1/spaces/{space_id}/personal_access_tokens` |
| Get agents in a space | GET | `/v1/spaces/{space_id}/agents` |
| Get credit usage for agents | GET | `/v1/spaces/{space_id}/agents/credit_usage` |
| Get credit usage for one agent | GET | `/v1/spaces/{space_id}/agents/{agent_id}/credit_usage` |
| Get an agent's sharing permissions | GET | `/v1/spaces/{space_id}/agents/{agent_id}/permissions` |

The Admin API is inconsistent about the cursor parameter name. Some endpoints take `start_cursor` and some take `cursor`. Check each endpoint's parameters rather than assuming one name.

## 2. Deprecated items and replacements

| Item | Method | Path | Replacement | Version |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `after` parameter on Append block children | PATCH | `/v1/blocks/{block_id}/children` | `position` object, for example `{"type":"after_block","after_block":{"id":"…"}}`, `{"type":"start"}` | 2026-03-11 |
| `archived` field in all requests and responses | all | all | `in_trash` | 2026-03-11 |
| `transcription` block type | n/a | n/a | Renamed to `meeting_notes` (the Meeting notes endpoints are under `/v1/blocks/meeting_notes`) | 2026-03-11 |
| Database query and property-schema pages ("Post database query", "Update database properties (legacy)") | POST | `/v1/databases/{id}/query` | `/v1/data_sources/...`. You now need data source IDs to manage properties and query. | 2025-09-03 |
| Page properties read from the page object | GET | `/v1/pages/{page_id}` | Page property item endpoint (`/v1/pages/{page_id}/properties/{property_id}`) | 2022-06-28 |
| `insert_content` command | PATCH | `/v1/pages/{page_id}/markdown` | `update_content` or `replace_content` | not stated |
| `replace_content_range` command | PATCH | `/v1/pages/{page_id}/markdown` | `update_content` | not stated |
| `cursor` query parameter | GET | `/admin/v1/mcp_client_connections` | `start_cursor` | not stated |
| `cursor` query parameter | GET | `/admin/v1/spaces/{space_id}/personal_access_tokens` | `start_cursor` | not stated |

- **Version gaps:** The two markdown commands and the two Admin `cursor` parameters are flagged `deprecated` in the specs, but I found no version in the specs or docs. The markdown reference says they are "still supported". The latest Admin version I saw is `2026-06-01`.
- **Database query page:** The specs I pulled no longer include `/v1/databases/{id}/query`. That row comes from the docs index and the 2025-09-03 changelog entry, not from a `deprecated` flag.

## 3. Admin API only

The Admin API uses separate `adm_…` tokens and its own spec. All of these are Admin-only.

| Endpoint | Method | Path |
|---|---|---|
| Get AI usage analytics report | GET | `/v1/analytics/ai_usage/reports/{job_id}` |
| Get content pages analytics report | GET | `/v1/analytics/content_pages/reports/{job_id}` |
| Get user activity analytics report | GET | `/v1/analytics/user_activity/reports/{job_id}` |
| List analytics reports | GET | `/v1/analytics/reports` |
| List legal holds | GET | `/v1/legal_holds` |
| Create a legal hold | POST | `/v1/legal_holds` |
| Retrieve a legal hold | GET | `/v1/legal_holds/{legal_hold_id}` |
| Update a legal hold | PATCH | `/v1/legal_holds/{legal_hold_id}` |
| Export a legal hold | POST | `/v1/legal_holds/{legal_hold_id}/export` |
| Release a legal hold | POST | `/v1/legal_holds/{legal_hold_id}/release` |
| List users on a legal hold | GET | `/v1/legal_holds/{legal_hold_id}/users` |
| Add users to a legal hold | POST | `/v1/legal_holds/{legal_hold_id}/users` |
| Remove a user from a legal hold | DELETE | `/v1/legal_holds/{legal_hold_id}/users/{user_id}` |
| List workspaces on a legal hold | GET | `/v1/legal_holds/{legal_hold_id}/workspaces` |
| List pages on a legal hold | GET | `/v1/legal_holds/{legal_hold_id}/spaces/{space_id}/pages` |
| Enqueue a workspace export | POST | `/v1/spaces/{space_id}/exports` |
| Get workspace export status | GET | `/v1/spaces/{space_id}/exports/{export_job_id}` |
| Revoke a managed user's sessions | POST | `/v1/managed_users/revoke_session` |
| List users | GET | `/v1/spaces/{space_id}/users` |
| List MCP client connections | GET | `/v1/mcp_client_connections` |
| Revoke an MCP client connection | POST | `/v1/mcp_client_connections/revoke` |
| Deny or restore enterprise-managed MCP access | PUT | `/v1/mcp_client_connections/enterprise_managed_access` |
| List groups | GET | `/v1/spaces/{space_id}/groups` |
| Create a group | POST | `/v1/spaces/{space_id}/groups` |
| Retrieve a group | GET | `/v1/spaces/{space_id}/groups/{group_id}` |
| Update a group | PATCH | `/v1/spaces/{space_id}/groups/{group_id}` |
| Delete a group | DELETE | `/v1/spaces/{space_id}/groups/{group_id}` |
| List group members | GET | `/v1/spaces/{space_id}/groups/{group_id}/members` |
| Add a group member | POST | `/v1/spaces/{space_id}/groups/{group_id}/members` |
| Update a group member | PATCH | `/v1/spaces/{space_id}/groups/{group_id}/members/users/{user_id}` |
| Remove a group member | DELETE | `/v1/spaces/{space_id}/groups/{group_id}/members/users/{user_id}` |
| List personal access tokens | GET | `/v1/spaces/{space_id}/personal_access_tokens` |
| Revoke a personal access token | DELETE | `/v1/spaces/{space_id}/personal_access_tokens/{bot_id}` |
| Get agents in a space | GET | `/v1/spaces/{space_id}/agents` |
| Get credit usage for agents | GET | `/v1/spaces/{space_id}/agents/credit_usage` |
| Get credit usage for one agent | GET | `/v1/spaces/{space_id}/agents/{agent_id}/credit_usage` |
| Get an agent's sharing permissions | GET | `/v1/spaces/{space_id}/agents/{agent_id}/permissions` |
| Update an agent's sharing permissions | PATCH | `/v1/spaces/{space_id}/agents/{agent_id}/permissions` |

| Disable or re-enable an agent | PATCH | `/v1/spaces/{space_id}/agents/{agent_id}/status` |
| Delete an agent | DELETE | `/v1/spaces/{space_id}/agents/{agent_id}` |
| Update the agent creation policy | PATCH | `/v1/spaces/{space_id}/agents/creation_policy` |
| Update the workspace default credit limit | PATCH | `/v1/spaces/{space_id}/credit_limit` |
